entities.summary: Wilton Álvaro Guerrero is a Dominican former professional baseball second baseman. He played for the Los Angeles Dodgers (1996–1998), Montreal Expos, Cincinnati Reds (2001–2002), and Kansas City Royals (2004) of Major League Baseball. He is the older brother of Baseball Hall of Famer Vladimir Guerrero, cousin of Cristian Guerrero, and uncle of Vladimir Guerrero Jr..
